structure.note: One class of common stock; 565,542,993 shares were outstanding on the April 13, 2026 record date. Nasdaq's charter generally bars any shareholder from voting more than 5% of total voting power, and an agreement limits Borse Dubai's voting power to 4.35%. Holders above 5%: Vanguard 10.5%, Investor AB 10.3%, Borse Dubai 10.3%, Wellington 7.3% and BlackRock 5.3%.

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (matches data.js fy 'Dec 2025'). Filings: FY2025 Form 10-K (accession 0001628280-26-007703, filed February 12, 2026) and 2026 proxy statement (accession 0001628280-26-027245, filed April 24, 2026; record date April 13, 2026), both read on www.sec.gov. ADENA FRIEDMAN (Chair and CEO): 1,965,986 shares, including 147,000 shares gifted to two family trusts for her children; less than 1% (marked * in the proxy), so pctEconomic is null. The outstanding count is printed '565.542,993' in the proxy. HOLDERS: the three largest are kept. Wellington (7.3%) and BlackRock (5.3%) are left out by the three-holder limit and named in the structure note; Thoma Bravo no longer appears among 5% holders. The proxy reports each 'as of the record date' but bases each on an earlier filing (Vanguard 13G/A Oct 6, 2025; Investor AB Form 4 Feb 13, 2026; Borse Dubai 13D/A Mar 22, 2024; BlackRock 13G Jan 31, 2024, stale), so asOf is null. Vanguard's footnote adds that a March 27, 2026 13G/A reported an internal realignment under which some Vanguard subsidiaries now report separately; the 10.5% is the aggregated October 2025 figure. Borse Dubai is typed 'company': the proxy describes it only as a wholly owned subsidiary of Investment Corporation of Dubai. BUYBACKS exclude $69 million of 'Payments related to employee shares withheld for taxes' and $4 million of accrued, unpaid excise tax. ROUNDING: dividends 601 -> 0.60, buybacks 616 -> 0.62, stock comp 165 -> 0.17 (half-up). GEOGRAPHY: total revenues of $8,262 million are gross, before transaction-based expenses (revenues less transaction-based expenses were $5,249 million).

taxes.notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Taxes: us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet, net of refunds, from the income-tax note's ASU 2023-09 table (federal 107, state and local 72, foreign 194; total 373 million), which matches the supplemental cash-flow line. R&D not reported as a separate line in the FY2025 10-K.

paidout.notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (FY2025 Form 10-K, accession 0001628280-26-007703). Exchange operator: normal operating cash flow, so the formula applies with the sector flag. Total revenues (8,262) are gross of transaction-based expenses paid to market participants; revenues less transaction-based expenses were 5,249. Those rebates and fees are payments to others, so they stay in. Default-fund and margin-deposit flows of the clearing house sit in investing and financing, not operating. Interest and income taxes paid are inside operating cash flow (US GAAP), so they are not added. No separate intangible-purchase line; no acquisitions in 2025 (divestiture proceeds of 140 are not netted).

owners.notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. The CalPERS percentage divides its September 30, 2026 shares by the Q3 2026 10-Q cover count at October 16, 2026, the same count used in the marketcap lens. Holders of record are registered holders only; most shares are held in street name.
